patterns.note: A pervasive, light-colored grid pattern with rounded cell borders overlays the entire page as a background texture, creating a structured yet soft visual foundation.
Content sections and interactive elements are frequently enclosed within thick-bordered frames with rounded corners, visually segmenting the page content.
The brand name 'Beaucoup.' is rendered in a highly ornate, blackletter-style display font, contrasting sharply with the modern serif headings and clean sans-serif body text.
A high-contrast palette of off-white background and black text is punctuated by a vibrant, electric blue used exclusively for interactive elements, accents, and the cookie banner.

Key interactive elements like the main logo, navigation menu, and a prominent call-to-action button ('SEE OUR WORK' / 'CONTACT US') remain sticky at the top and right of the viewport as the user scrolls.
Project showcases are presented as alternating image-text blocks within framed sections, creating a dynamic yet organized portfolio display.

technique_notes: The site uses a repeating background image or a CSS grid with rounded cell borders to create a subtle, textured grid overlay that scrolls with the page content.
Content sections are visually framed by applying a thick border and a consistent border-radius to their container elements.
The header elements and specific call-to-action buttons are implemented with a fixed or sticky positioning strategy, ensuring they remain visible and accessible during scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, ornate blackletter for the brand name, large elegant serifs for main headings (~3-4x body), and a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and labels.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently applied across the grid cells, framed sections, buttons, and image containers, giving a soft, rounded character.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between main sections and ample padding within framed content blocks.

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the omnipresent, light-colored grid overlay with rounded cells, which acts as a unique background texture and frames content. This, combined with the bold, ornate blackletter typography for the brand name and elegant display serifs, creates a highly sophisticated and editorial aesthetic that feels both structured and luxurious.
